question: Can existing point-volatility OOS artifacts be re-evaluated with CRPS, pinball loss, coverage, and MCS?

scope.claim: coverage-limited evaluation-layer audit, not full 1400+ K re-ranking

method.distribution_wrapper: point variance forecast mu_t converted to mean-mu lognormal predictive distribution; sigma estimated on each panel/model calibration slice only
method.calibration: first max(80, 25%) rows capped at half sample; evaluation uses later rows only
method.mcs: range-statistic MCS-lite, alpha=0.1, moving-block bootstrap B=500, block=10
method.lookahead_policy: No new forecasts are fit; distribution dispersion is calibrated only on pre-evaluation OOS rows.

limitations: Most historical K experiments do not store full predictive distributions or per-date loss rows.
Lognormal wrapper is a transparent post-processing proxy; it does not turn point forecasts into native probabilistic models.
Cross-panel aggregate rankings are descriptive because targets and horizons differ.
Primary inference is per panel; global winner counts are a platform audit signal, not a universal model theorem.
